In detail

Leicestershire Police recorded 750 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 13.3 per 1,000 residents, the 4th highest rate of Leicester's 21 wards. The daytime score here is driven by vehicle crime (11), shoplifting (9), drugs (7); the evening/night score by violent crime (104), anti social behaviour (32), public order (23). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Beaumont Leys safe?

Wandroz currently rates Beaumont Leys in Leicester as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Leicester during the day and an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Leicester at night. This rating is derived from Leicestershire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Beaumont Leys safe at night?

At night, Beaumont Leys is rated as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Leicester. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Beaumont Leys a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Beaumont Leys's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Leicester) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
